purpose.zh: 在全身负重下练肩胛下压
purpose.en: Train shoulder depression while holding your full body weight.

text.zh: 手臂锁直，用力下压把身体顶高
text.en: Lock your arms and press your shoulders down to lift your body
First let your shoulders rise slowly toward your ears.

text.zh: 顶端停1秒，双腿伸直并拢
text.en: Hold for one second at the top with your legs straight together.

commonErrors.en: Bending the elbows so it turns into a dip.

cautions.zh: 肩前侧夹痛时缩短时长或改简单版本，不要硬撑
cautions.en: If the front of your shoulder pinches, shorten the set or use an easier version.
